name: Unarmored
description: No armor worn. Some characters intentionally build around speed, mobility, or skill without protective gear.
narrative_effects: No baseline Agility difficulty impact under normal conditions.

name: Padded
description: Layered quilted protection that offers basic defense without materially hindering mobility under ordinary conditions.
narrative_effects: Supports light protection framing with no baseline Agility difficulty impact under normal conditions.

name: Leather
description: Flexible leather armor that balances protection and movement, common among scouts, hunters, and lightly equipped fighters.
narrative_effects: Supports light protection framing with no baseline Agility difficulty impact under normal conditions.

name: Hide
description: Thicker hide armor offering rugged protection while remaining within the light armor category.
narrative_effects: Supports light protection framing with no baseline Agility difficulty impact under normal conditions.

name: Chain Shirt
description: A lighter chain-based armor that offers stronger coverage than light gear while preserving more mobility than heavier battlefield harnesses.
narrative_effects: May increase Agility difficulty by one step in demanding physical contexts, depending on situation and judgment.

name: Scale Mail
description: Overlapping scale armor built for practical battlefield defense with moderate bulk and movement cost.
narrative_effects: May increase Agility difficulty by one step in demanding physical contexts, depending on situation and judgment.

name: Breastplate
description: A shaped torso plate paired with lighter supporting materials, offering strong core protection without the full burden of heavy armor.
narrative_effects: May increase Agility difficulty by one step in demanding physical contexts, depending on situation and judgment.

name: Chain Mail
description: A full battlefield chain harness that provides serious protection at the cost of agility and physical ease.
narrative_effects: Increases Agility difficulty by one step as a baseline and by two steps in demanding physical contexts.

name: Splint
description: A heavy segmented armor built for strong defense and battlefield durability with substantial movement cost.
narrative_effects: Increases Agility difficulty by one step as a baseline and by two steps in demanding physical contexts.

name: Plate
description: The heaviest common battlefield armor, offering maximum conventional protection with major mobility burden outside trained use.
narrative_effects: Increases Agility difficulty by one step as a baseline and by two steps in demanding physical contexts.

name: Shield
description: A general shield entry. Specific size and type are handled narratively at runtime rather than as separate catalog items.
narrative_effects: Supports active defensive framing. Movement and handling impact depend on described size and type, judged at runtime.

name: Sabatons
description: Armored foot protection worn with plate or heavy combat gear to guard the feet and ankles during battle.
narrative_effects: Provides heavy foot and ankle protection; increases Agility difficulty by one step as a baseline with other heavy armor.

name: Gauntlets
description: Heavy protective hand-wear for combat, armor use, and maximum hand and wrist protection.
narrative_effects: Provides heavy hand and wrist protection; increases fine manipulation difficulty in demanding contexts.

name: Bracers
description: Forearm guards for added protection, archery support, and light combat defense without covering the hands.
narrative_effects: Supports forearm protection and archery string clearance with no baseline Agility difficulty impact.

name: Studded Leather
description: Leather armor reinforced with metal studs or rivets for improved protection while maintaining light armor mobility.
narrative_effects: Supports light protection framing with no baseline Agility difficulty impact under normal conditions.

name: Thornmere Vinework Armor
description: Living vine-woven light armor produced by House Thornmere's defensive vinework tradition — grown to the wearer's measurements over weeks and tended through the wearer's life.
narrative_effects: Provides flexible light-armor protection without the movement restriction of fitted plate or scale.
Is tended rather than repaired — Thornmere armorers maintain continuity of the living material across the wearer's working life.
Non-elf bearers are rare; the armor is given in the context of sustained relationship with the house rather than sold.

name: Feywood Ranger's Leathers
description: A Feywood ranger's layered leather armor — tanned from sanctioned hides (silverbough hart, gladehorn stag, rootback elk) using elven processes that preserve flexibility across long service.
narrative_effects: Provides medium-armor protection with the quieter motion elven field operation demands.
Often bears subtle house-marks or personal identifiers recognizable only to trained elven observers.

name: Heartwarden Vestments
description: The sworn Heartwarden's combat vestments — layered elven textile-and-leather construction integrating woven Thornveil Vine elements at reinforcement points, worn during Watch rotations and formal duties.
narrative_effects: Provides light-armor protection with exceptional mobility appropriate to Heartwarden protective doctrine.
Not issued to non-Heartwardens; unsanctioned possession by a non-Heartwarden is a significant breach of elven sacred order.

name: Ironroot Shield
description: An elven shield with Ironroot hardwood core and elven metalwork rim — lighter than realm steel shields of equivalent protection, harvested from sanctioned deadfall and coordinated with House Ironsap.
narrative_effects: Supports standard active defense with lighter carry weight than steel equivalents.
Ironroot material does not warp or split under long service; shields serve across generations.
